notes: Listed in the catalog as the 'Materials physics' focus area within the BS, Physics (PY29) degree, not a separate degree code. Full requirement set = BS Physics core plus five restricted electives from the materials-physics focus list. Focus list verified verbatim.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Lab
buckets.note: One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150 (4 units). PHYS 133 also appears in this focus list.

buckets.label: Restricted Electives (Materials Physics focus)
buckets.note: Five restricted electives (20 units), 4+ units each; max two from outside physics (CHEM/ECE/MAE). Catalog verbatim: 'Materials physics: PHYS 133, 152A-B; CHEM 120A-B; ECE 103, 134, 135A-B, 136L; MAE 160.'

buckets.label: Total Units for the Major
buckets.note: 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division units (same as base BS). Total/minimum unit count for the major, not a course set. Catalog states 109 units for BS Physics (Materials Physics focus): 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division. Satisfied by completing the major's course buckets; no separate course list applies.
